summary: Microbiome-friendly oral defense. An alcohol-free rinse that neutralizes bad breath and gingivitis without destroying the mouth's healthy bacteria.
description: Precision bacterial targeting. Traditional alcohol washes indiscriminately burn all oral flora. This formula utilizes targeted CPC to dismantle plaque-causing biofilms while maintaining a hydrated, balanced oral ecosystem.
technical_overview: Offered at $16.0 for 500ml, this KoColor MOUTHWASH is expertly formulated with Water, Cetylpyridinium Chloride (CPC), Xylitol, and Aloe. It delivers a high-fidelity Ice Blue color profile (`#AFEEEE`) and leverages selective biofilm degradation.

dynamic_attributes.label: Usage Notes
dynamic_attributes.body: Swish 20ml vigorously for 60 seconds after brushing.

dynamic_attributes.label: Expert Tip
dynamic_attributes.body: Wait at least 30 minutes after brushing to use mouthwash so you don't immediately wash away the toothpaste's active remineralizing agents.

dynamic_attributes.label: Formulation Insight
dynamic_attributes.body: Entirely alcohol-free to prevent the rapid dehydration of the oral mucosa, which paradoxically worsens bad breath.
